senses.gloss:
Mahādhammacakkapavattanasutta
from Saṃyuttanikāya of Suttapiṭaka.
Pt.. with Burmese interpretation, Rangoon, 1914. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28, 1066. 1396.

Mahādhammasamādānasutta
6th sutta of the 5th part of the Majjhimanikāya. Stockholm Pāli p. 150.
-C. Colombo D. I. 239.

Mahādhavalā(mahābandha)
Jain. Pkt. 6th khaṇḍa of Ṣaṭkhaṇḍāgama of Bhūtabali (on Karmasiddhānta). Moodbidri D.. p. 257 (3 mss.). National Mus. ND. p. 41 (with Dharasena).
Pt.. Pkt. text with Hindi transl. in seven volumes. Vol. I. ed. by Pandit Candra Diwakar Sastri. Vol.. II-VII. ed. by Pt. Phoolachandra, Jñānapīṭha Mūrtidevī Jaina granthamālā Ser. 6, Prākṛt work Nos. 1, 4-9. Bhāratīya Jñānapīṭha, Kashi, 1947, 1953.

Mahādhipati(yajvā)
of Tintṛṇī family.
-Āvarṇi. list of words in Ṛv an. Yv. beginning with ā merging with the last vowel of the preceeding words. See under the text. Adyar D. I. 740 (Ṛv.). 741-44 (Yv.).
-C. on his Āvarṇi. See under the text.
Addl. mss.:
Mysore N. D. II. 3117. Trav. Uni. 5512-A.
